searchText: What would Ethereum lose if we no longer included logsbloom, receiptsroot and gasused in block header? Logs Bloom: In theory, increased network traffic for stateless clients as they can't make an educated guess whether or not a block contains a log of interest when they only have the header. Receipts Root: Stateless: wouldn't be able to prove receipts, you would have to execute the block locally (with witnesses, this may be fine). Gas Used: Stateless: Can't calculate the next base fee without executing the block. `s/stateless/light client` maybe. Nuke logsbloom from orbit. witnesses are a better solution for the light client needs.
